subject: POC roadmap, model guardrails & evaluation plan for AtlasPay trial
messages:
From: James Kline <james.kline@atlaspay.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed timeline for AtlasPay POC

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciated the crisp walkthrough. Quick recap and asks from our side so we can get internal approval:

- Goal: Replace rule-based response suggestions in AtlasPay support flow with a domain-tuned LLM that handles billing/chargebacks and payments FAQ.
- Priority locales: en (US), es (Mexico), fr (Canada) — primary support traffic is EN, then ES.
- Success signals we care about: reduction in average handle time (AHT) by >=20%, suggestion acceptance rate >=65%, and <5% critical hallucinations on billing prompts.
- Security/compliance: we need SOC2 evidence and confirmation that customer training data can be kept private; legal will request a short data handling note.

Proposed POC cadence: kickoff next week (Nov 23), 2-week dataset upload + baseline eval, 2-week model tuning/eval, final demo + decision by Dec 21.

Attachments: call-1-notes.pdf (meeting notes), sample-prompts.csv (500 anonymized prompts)

Could Redwood propose the open model candidate + fallback, plus a concise success-metrics template we can drop into our internal evaluation? Also confirm any seat/license fees for a short trial.

—James
Director of Product, AtlasPay
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: James Kline <james.kline@atlaspay.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed timeline for AtlasPay POC

James — thanks for the clear recap. This looks feasible and we can tighten the timeline slightly depending on dataset availability. High-level replies and a recommended plan below.

Recommended open model candidates (trial):
- Primary: Llama-3-13B-Chat (quantized nvllm-friendly build) — strong instruction-following, good latency/cost balance.
- Fallback: Llama-2-7B (8-bit quant) — fast and cheap, used only for short fallback responses when latency SLOs are threatened.

Multilingual approach:
- Core training/eval on EN dataset. Parallel evaluation sets in ES and FR to measure parity. For initial trial we'll provide prompt templates and run evals in all three locales, concentrating tuning on EN then selected ES intents.

Success metrics template (attached): fields for AHT delta, suggestion acceptance, precision on intent classification, hallucination incidents per 1k responses, latency P95. Target thresholds proposed: AHT <= -20%, acceptance >=65%, hallucinations <5% on sampled billing queries, P95 latency <250ms.

Security/compliance: we'll attach a short data handling note (SOC2 controls we cover, encryption in transit/at-rest, optional VPC for Private trials). Legal can route more detailed asks to our security team.

POC timing (proposed):
- Nov 23: kickoff + SOW sign-off (1 day)
- Nov 24–Dec 7: data ingestion, sample pipeline, baseline run on Llama-2-7B and Llama-3-13B
- Dec 8–Dec 21: tuning, multilang evals, user-acceptance testing (UAT)
- Dec 22–Dec 23: final demo + decision

Ownership:
- Redwood PM (soojin_lee) — overall POC lead, kickoff, demo
- Redwood infra/ML (rishi_malhotra) — model builds, quantization, latency tuning
- AtlasPay product (James) — dataset owner and acceptance criteria

Costs: hosted trial credits cover baseline runs; we'll follow up with a short quote for dedicated seats if you want guaranteed throughput.

Attachments: redwood-poc-success-template.xlsx; data-handling-note.pdf

If that aligns, we'll prepare a short SOW and a one-page decision checklist for your legal/finance.

Cheers,
Soogin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@atlaspay.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, James Kline <james.kline@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed timeline for AtlasPay POC

Thanks — quick clarifications from product/legal: 
- We can provide the 500 anonymized prompts now; engineering can share a sanitized transaction set by Nov 24.
- Multilingual priority: EN > ES > FR, but ES needs parity on top 20 intents. If tuning cost is prohibitive, we’d accept best-effort for FR in pilot.
- Data handling note: can you confirm deletion policy for uploaded prompts after the trial? Legal will want 90-day purge or retention-by-request.

Also: Are there any constraints on tokenization or prompt size we should be aware of for billing workflows (many long receipts)?

—Priya
Head of Support Automation, AtlasPay
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@atlaspay.com>
Cc: James Kline <james.kline@atlaspay.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed timeline for AtlasPay POC

Priya / team — technical notes and recommended guardrails below.

1) Tokenization & long receipts: We recommend a two-step pipeline: (A) client-side truncation + key-entity extraction to reduce token lengths for receipts, (B) a secondary search-index call if receipts exceed 1,500 tokens. We'll provide a small client helper for deterministic extraction.

2) Quantization / latency: For the hosted trial we will ship Llama-3-13B in a q4_k_mixed quant profile which gives ~2.6x lower memory and keeps P95 latency ~180–240ms on our dedicated inference nodes. Fallback Llama-2-7B in 8-bit compressed build should hit P95 ~110–140ms and will be used for short-answer fallbacks and low-cost baseline comparisons.

3) Evaluation harness: We'll run the following automatically: intent accuracy, suggestion acceptance simulation (based on your historical accept/reject labels), hallucination detection via a small ground-truth set (200 queries), latency P50/P95, and cost per 1M tokens. We'll share a Jupyter notebook plus an interactive dashboard link.

4) Data deletion: we support automated purge. Default: artifacts from trial (uploaded prompts & derived embeddings) are deleted 30 days after trial end; can extend to 90 days if AtlasPay legal requests it.

I'll prepare the image build and a short doc with exact hardware profiles.

—Rishi
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: James Kline <james.kline@atlaspay.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@atlaspay.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed timeline for AtlasPay POC

All — thanks for the quick clarifications. Finalized plan below; please reply with any last blockers. If none, we’ll kick on Nov 23 as proposed.

Final POC plan (condensed):
- Kickoff: Nov 23 (30m): SOW sign + dataset handoff owner (Priya)
- Phase 1 (Nov 24–Dec 7): Baseline runs on Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-13B; ingestion + client extraction helper; run baseline metrics.
- Phase 2 (Dec 8–Dec 21): Tuning on top-ranked intents, multilingual evals (EN/ES/FR), acceptance testing.
- Deliverables: evaluation report (metrics table), dashboard link, short SOW report for legal (data deletion confirmation), final demo.

Success criteria (for go/no-go):
- AHT reduction >=20% measured in the UAT simulated stream
- Suggestion acceptance >=65% on sampled sessions
- Hallucination incidents <5% on billing-critical queries
- P95 latency <250ms for primary model; fallback P95 <150ms
- Cost target: under $x per 1M tokens (we will provide a concrete figure in the quote)

Owners & next actions:
- AtlasPay: upload anonymized prompts + sanitized receipts by Nov 24 (Priya)
- Redwood infra/ML (Rishi): provision builds and share evaluation notebook by Nov 26
- Redwood PM (Soogin): send SOW + one-page decision checklist by EOD Nov 21

Attachments referenced: redwood-poc-success-template.xlsx; data-handling-note.pdf; sample-prompts.csv
Related links: HubSpot deal ATL-2026-11-20-01 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ATL-2026-11-20-01), Drive SOW draft (https://drive.google.com/s/0ABC123example)

If that looks good I’ll send the SOW and calendar invite for Nov 23 kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Soogin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
